operation.name: live stack
operation.description:
Initializes a livestacking session, using the optional calibration files and waits for input files to be provided by the LIVESTACK command until STOP_LS is called. Default processing will use shift-only registration and 16-bit processing because it's faster, it can be changed to rotation with -rotate and -32bits

Note that the live stacking commands put Siril in a state in which it's not able to process other commands. After START_LS, only LIVESTACK, STOP_LS and EXIT can be called until STOP_LS is called to return Siril in its normal, non-live-stacking, state

Links: livestack , stop_ls , exit

Process the provided image for live stacking. Only possible after START_LS. The process involves calibrating the incoming file if configured in START_LS, demosaicing if it's an OSC image, registering and stacking. The temporary result will be in the file live_stack_00001.fit until a new option to change it is added

Links: start_ls

Stops the live stacking session. Only possible after START_LS

Links: start_ls

Uses fixed input references and writes only invocation-owned outputs. Optional argument values are sent only when their use_* control is true; zero is preserved.

A finite fixed group is consumed in order; GUI file watching is not provided by Siril headless.

runtime is a JSON object. Supported keys: ini, settings, threads, memory_ratio, output_bits, compression, online, selection, findstar, photometry. Networking starts offline and must be enabled explicitly. Selection is omitted for the whole image or explicitly null to clear it; optional CLI arguments use separate use_* controls. Connect transforms to an explicit export, stacking, or analysis endpoint. Only requested dependencies are executed; previews do not make other branches endpoints. Saved output references identify complete checked files, never preview pixels. See reference/coverage.json and docs/usage.md.
limitations: A finite fixed group is consumed in order; GUI file watching is not provided by Siril headless.
